people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Jadon
people.line: Meronothite who helped repair Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.

people.name: Melatiah
people.line: Gibeonite who helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

people.name: Meronothite
people.line: A term used to describe two individuals in the Bible

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.
translations.bsb: Next to them, repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, who were under the authority of the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
translations.kjv: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
translations.asv: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, that appertained to the throne of the governor beyond the River.
